notes.title: 1.2 Delays
notes.notes:
Previously, I announced that Meeple Jump version 1.2 would be releasing on January 24th, 2024. Since then I have been juggling a few projects (including 1.2) and dealing with some burnout after the release of Meeple Jump, and the incredibly fast development cycle for version 1.1

In 1.2 I wanted to take time to fix some bugs and add some QOL that I feel the game has been missing, as well as add new cosmetics. 1.1 featured none of these, and therefore took a lot less time to develop. I will be announcing the updated release date for version 1.2 at a later date, so stay tuned! To apologize, I'll even show you the modified Meeple Jump logo that I made for version 1.2's new act!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43755868/ca8525bf942fe2eafcb849a4e1616fd2a4be182f.png[/img]

notes.title: V1.1
notes.notes:
The first of two acts in Part two is released! Along with that, I will be announcing the release date for Part two, Act two at the end of the patch notes!

Enter the rain, an ancient structure in the center of a lake, faithfully re-created in our wonderful training simulation! These structures are bigger than anything we've seen, so using the new cannons to traverse these ruins is a must.

(ok now for the changes)

1.1;01 - Added Part 2, Act 1.
1.1;02 - Added new level mechanic, the cannon assists the player to travel through larger levels in a short amount of time.
1.1;03 - Added a new crown accessory for completing Part 2, Act 1.
1.1;04 - Collected gems in a given level no longer disappear if you re-enter a level without having previously entered the teleporter.
1.1;05 - Fixed typo found in the English translation of the crown unlock screens.
1.1;06 - Crown unlock screens at the end of each act now properly translate to Spanish.
1.1;07 - Cancelling a new game startup no longer deletes any data.
1.1;08 - Fixed an issue related to change 1.0.2;01 in the crown unlock screens.
1.1;09 - Exiting the level selection screen now properly displays the act selection screen.
1.1;10 - Added 3 new achievements.


(as for the next update)

As development is pausing until the new year, it will be a bit of a longer wait until the next update. Even still, you won't have to wait too long as Part two, Act two will be releasing as part of Meeple Jump version 1.2 on January 24th, 2024! Until then, enjoy the new act!
